spec.mathematics: Top: 48d²e². Middle left: 8de. Base right: 3d. Middle right, base left and base middle are empty.

answer.short: Middle right: $6de$. Base left: $4d$; base middle: $2e$.
answer.worked:
Work backwards by dividing by the known factor.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Middle right}&=\frac{48d^2e^2}{8de}\\&=6de\\\text{Base middle}&=\frac{6de}{3d}\\&=2e\\\text{Base left}&=\frac{8de}{2e}\\&=4d\end{align*}$$
